review.summary: Reviewed both actual native GPU PNGs after restoring the shared live-host root typography, foreground and padding. Initial state shows Count: 0 and Doubled: 0; a native Increment click followed by an explicit 20 ms advance shows Count: 1 and Doubled: 2. The count assertion passed, both captures are coherent and teardown released every owner resource. Exact RGBA policy, no masks or tolerance; renderer/font/profile identities are retained in run/environment.json.
